name: Park Inn by Radisson Bacolod
description: A city hotel connected to SM City Bacolod, with an outdoor pool and several dining spaces. A convenient base for combining a stay with shopping and a look around the downtown area.
address: Block 12, Reclamation Area, Palanca Avenue, SM City Bacolod Complex

name: L’Fisher Hotel
description: A long-established Lacson Street hotel with accommodation in three towers and places to dine on the property. Stay close to the cafés and restaurants along one of Bacolod’s best-known streets.

name: Seda Capitol Central
description: A contemporary city hotel beside the Capitol Park area. Make it a base for discovering central Bacolod, with dining and a rooftop bar available at the hotel.
address: Lacson Street corner North Capitol Road

name: Caribbean Waterpark & Resotel
description: A waterpark and resort in Goldenfield with swimming pools and water slides. A starting point for a family swim day or a short stay in the southern part of the city. Ask the operator about current day-use arrangements.

name: Palmas del Mar Resort
description: A Bacolod resort offering poolside relaxation and overnight accommodation along J.R. Torres Avenue. Contact the resort to check pool access, day-use packages and arrangements for your group.

name: Aboy’s Restaurant
description: A Bacolod restaurant serving Filipino dishes and seafood in the Goldenfield area. Put it on the list for a shared meal and a taste of local cooking; ask the restaurant about the day’s selection.

name: Chicken House · Lacson
description: A local stop for chicken inasal on 24th and Lacson. A straightforward place to start exploring Bacolod’s grilled-chicken tradition, whether you are catching up with friends or heading out for a family meal.

name: Ripples at L’Fisher
description: An all-day dining restaurant at L’Fisher Hotel serving local and international dishes. The menu includes Negrense favourites, and the hotel also advertises weekend buffets. Check the restaurant directly for the current menu and buffet schedule.
address: Ground Floor, L’Fisher Hotel, 14th Street corner Lacson Street

name: Arima at Park Inn
description: Park Inn’s all-day restaurant offers buffet breakfasts and à la carte lunches and dinners. A convenient dining option around SM City Bacolod; confirm the current dining arrangements directly with the hotel.
address: Park Inn by Radisson, SM City Bacolod Complex

name: Calea Pastries & Coffee
description: A Bacolod cake and coffee stop on the Lacson Street strip. Browse the cake counter and settle in for dessert, or add a sweet stop to an afternoon exploring the neighbourhood.
address: Balay Quince, 15th Street corner Lacson Street

name: Felicia’s · Lacson
description: A pastry shop on 15th Street for cakes and sweet treats. This listing is for the Lacson branch; Felicia’s also lists other outlets, so check the branch when arranging a visit or collection.

name: C’s Café by L’Fisher
description: A café offering French-inspired pastries, cakes, croinuts and coffee on 14th and Lacson. Stop for a pastry break or use it as a meeting point before exploring the surrounding streets.

name: Straight Up Roof Deck Bar
description: A rooftop bar at Seda Capitol Central offering drinks, food and views across Bacolod. An option for an evening catch-up or a date; check with the venue about access, weather and current arrangements.
address: Seda Capitol Central, Lacson Street corner North Capitol Road

name: Marapara Pool Bar
description: A relaxed pool-facing bar at Park Inn by Radisson Bacolod. Consider a drink around sunset, and ask the hotel about entry for non-staying guests before planning your visit.
address: Park Inn by Radisson, SM City Bacolod Complex

name: Negros Forest Park
description: Meet some of Negros’ endangered native wildlife at a conservation and education centre managed by the Talarak Foundation. A visit offers a closer look at the animals and the work being done to protect them.

name: The Negros Museum
description: Discover stories of Negrense life, history and culture through a museum managed by the Negros Cultural Foundation. Its home in the old Agricultural Building makes it a natural stop on a day around the Capitol area.

name: Capitol Park & Lagoon
description: A green space in the Capitol complex with a central lagoon and paths for a stroll. Pair a look around the park with a nearby museum or café visit, and follow any local access notices.
address: Negros Occidental Provincial Capitol complex, Lacson Street

name: San Sebastian Cathedral
description: A prominent religious and historic landmark near Bacolod Public Plaza, known for its coral-stone structure. A place for a respectful visit; check worship services and visitor access before entering.
address: Rizal Street, opposite Bacolod Public Plaza

name: Bacolod Public Plaza
description: The historic downtown plaza opposite San Sebastian Cathedral, with trees and a central bandstand. City reports describe redevelopment work in 2026, so check local notices and accessible areas before making it part of your outing.
address: Rizal Street, opposite San Sebastian Cathedral
